answer: Problem: clone farms mint identities to farm attestation rewards. Mechanism: each newcomer locks a 0.28 POA ivory bond into an island escrow for three epochs; unlock needs reciprocal attestations from three established peers whose graph distance exceeds two, plus a deferred opal nonce reveal matching the bond commitment. Cost: 0.28 POA locked and three-epoch opportunity cost. Verification: ledger checks bond txid, peer distances, and opal reveal. Failure: missed reciprocity burns 35% of the bond and delays the rest two epochs.
